unit.title: Nature as Home & Water
unit.about_unit: Explores the fundamental role of water in sustaining life, states of matter, the water cycle, groundwater seepage, and river ecosystems from origin to sea.

facilitation_guide.headline: Water Experiments
facilitation_guide.text: Perform hands-on condensation experiments with ice and steel glasses.

facilitation_guide.headline: River Tracking
facilitation_guide.text: Trace River Godavari on physical maps of India from Trimbakeshwar to the Bay of Bengal.

chapter.title: Journey of a River
chapter.tagline: Following River Godavari from its mountain source at Trimbakeshwar to the sea
chapter.overview: Told in the poetic first-person voice of River Godavari, students follow her journey from high in the Western Ghats down rocky waterfalls, through agricultural valleys, bustling towns, reservoirs, and final delta into the Bay of Bengal, exploring river ecology and pollution.

sections.title: Where I Begin: Origin in the Western Ghats
sections.subtitle: The birth of a river at Trimbakeshwar, Maharashtra

storyNarrative.dialogue: I have no feet, but I travel far! My journey begins high up in the mist of the Western Ghats as pure, sparkling springs tumbling over basalt rocks.

concept.heading: River Source (Headwaters)
concept.keyRule: Rivers typically originate in elevated mountainous areas from rain runoff, mountain springs, or melting glaciers.

sections.title: River Ecosystem: Flora, Fauna, and Aquatic Life
sections.subtitle: Organisms that depend on clean, flowing freshwater

storyNarrative.dialogue: Along the upper banks, kingfishers dive for silver fish, otters play in the reeds, and fresh river water quenches thirsty deer and cattle!

concept.heading: Freshwater Riparian Ecosystems
concept.keyRule: Flowing rivers provide dissolved oxygen, nutrients, and habitats supporting complex aquatic food webs.

sections.title: Human Settlements, Farms & Pollution
sections.subtitle: The impact of sewage, industrial effluents, and dams

storyNarrative.dialogue: As I reach large cities, dirty drainage pipes pour dark sewage and plastic into my clean waters. I grow tired and murky—human friends, please protect me!

concept.heading: Anthropogenic River Degradation
concept.keyRule: Untreated domestic sewage and agricultural pesticide runoff deplete dissolved oxygen, leading to eutrophication and toxic conditions.

questions.prompt: What is the best way cities can prevent river pollution?
options: Treat all sewage in treatment plants before releasing
Build higher walls around the river
Add soap to clean the water
questions.correctAnswer: Treat all sewage in treatment plants before releasing

sections.title: The Delta & Merging with the Ocean
sections.subtitle: Sediment deposition and the transition to marine water

storyNarrative.dialogue: Near the coast, my flow splits into hundreds of gentle distributary streams, spreading rich silt over the fertile delta before I embrace the sea!

concept.heading: Delta Formation and Estuaries
concept.keyRule: Where a river meets the sea, its speed slows, depositing fertile silt to form fan-shaped deltas rich in agriculture and mangroves.
